title: Shielding the Mind
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 1.24 Linked Discourses 1.24
  • 3. Sattivagga 3. A Sword

Manonivāraṇasutta Shielding the Mind

“Yato yato mano nivāraye, “Whatever you’ve shielded the mind from Na dukkhameti naṁ tato tato; can’t cause you suffering. Sa sabbato mano nivāraye, So you should shield the mind from everything, Sa sabbato dukkhā pamuccatī”ti. then you’re freed from all suffering.”

“Na sabbato mano nivāraye, “You need not shield the mind from everything, Na mano saṁyatattamāgataṁ; nor has the mind gained self-control. Yato yato ca pāpakaṁ, The mind need only be shielded Tato tato mano nivāraye”ti. from where the bad things come.”
